entries.question: Procedure for CETC Scan for admitted patient
entries.answer:
For an admitted patient requiring a CECT (Contrast-Enhanced Computed Tomography) scan at KGMU, the procedure typically involves the following steps:

1. **Requisition:** The treating physician or resident doctor fills out the official radiological investigation requisition form with clinical details and the specific type of CECT scan required.
2. **Consent & Preparation:** Informed consent is obtained from the patient or attendant. Blood investigations (such as serum creatinine) may be required beforehand to check kidney function, especially when intravenous contrast media is used.
3. **Scheduling:** The form is submitted to the Department of Radiodiagnosis (or the relevant imaging counter) to obtain an appointment date and time, unless it is an emergency procedure handled directly through the emergency/trauma services.
4. **Transport & Execution:** The patient is transported safely from the ward to the Radiodiagnosis department by hospital staff along with necessary medical support as dictated by their condition. Following the scan, the patient returns to the ward, and reports are processed according to the department's turnaround time.

For specific departmental inquiries or urgent imaging coordination, you can contact the Radiodiagnosis department or refer to the official [Radiodiagnosis Department details](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=28&dept_type=2).

entries.answer:
Sabse achha dental cap (crown) aapke daant ki sthiti, zaroorat aur budget par nirbhar karta hai:

1. **Zirconia Crowns:** Agar aapko zabardast majbooti (strength) ke sath-sath ekdam natural aur sundar look chahiye, toh Zirconia caps ko sabse behtar maana jata hai. Yeh lambe samay tak chalte hain aur aage ya pichle dono tarah ke daanton ke liye acche hote hain.
2. **All-Ceramic / All-Porcelain Crowns:** Agar aap aage ke daanton (front teeth) ke liye cap lagwa rahe hain jahan dikhavat sabse mahatvapurna hoti hai, toh All-Ceramic caps sabse accha aesthetic look dete hain kyunki inka rang asli daanton jaisa match hota hai.
3. **Porcelain-Fused-to-Metal (PFM):** Yeh majbooti aur acchhe look ka ek badhiya aur economical combination hote hain.

Aapke daant ke liye kaun sa cap sabse upyukt rahega, iska sahi faisla KGMU ke **Prosthodontics** ya **Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics** department ke doctor aapki jaanch karne ke baad hi bata sakte hain. 

Aap adhik jankari ke liye [KGMU Prosthodontics Department](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=44&dept_type=1) ya [Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics Department](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=42&dept_type=1) ki official website dekh sakte hain.

entries.question: Rct ke bad teeth cape price
entries.answer:
The price for a dental crown (cap) at KGMU depends on the specific material chosen. According to the official [KGMU Rate List](https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm), conservative dental procedures and treatments range from ₹50 to ₹1,500. 

For the exact current pricing of different types of dental caps (such as ceramic, metal, or zirconia), please inquire directly at the Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics department or the hospital billing counter during your visit.

entries.question: Yha per padhne ke liye mujhe kya karna hoga
entries.answer:
KGMU mein padhne (admission) ke liye aapko university ke dwara conduct ki jaane wali entrance examinations (jaise NEET, KGMU Nursing, Paramedical, etc.) ya National level entrance exams ko qualify karna hota hai. 

Courses aur admissions se judi poori jaankari aur latest updates ke liye aap official admissions page dekh sakte hain:
[KGMU Admissions](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

entries.question: Kitne type ke dental cap hote hai
entries.answer:
KGMU ratelist aur dental departments ke anusaar, dental caps (crowns) ke kai mukhyakar ke prakar hote hain jo patients ki zaroorat aur budget ke hisaab se use kiye jaate hain:

1. **Metal / Base Metal Crowns:** Yeh kaafi majboot hote hain aur zyadatar pichle daanton (molars) ke liye use kiye jaate hain jahan zyada dabav padta hai.
2. **Porcelain-Fused-to-Metal (PFM) Crowns:** Isme andar metal hota hai aur upar porcelain (daant ke rang ka) coating hoti hai, jisse majbooti ke sath-sath natural look bhi milta hai.
3. **All-Ceramic / All-Porcelain Crowns:** Yeh aage ke daanton ke liye behtar maane jaate hain kyunki yeh bilkul asli daanton jaisa dikhte hain aur aesthetic appearance dete hain.
4. **Zirconia Crowns:** Yeh bahut hi durable aur strong ceramic material ke bane hote hain, jo dikhne mein bhi natural hote hain aur lambe samay tak chalte hain.

KGMU ke Prosthodontics ya Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics department mein doctor aapke daant ki sthiti aur zaroorat ke hisaab se sabse accha option suggest karte hain. Aap [KGMU Prosthodontics Department](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=44&dept_type=1) ya [Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics Department](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=42&dept_type=1) ki official link par jaakar adhik jankari le sakte hain.
